rules.name: Trans Fat Limit
rules.description: Trans fat must not exceed 2% of total fat content.

rules.name: Aflatoxin B1 Limit
rules.description: Aflatoxin B1 is a potent carcinogen; max 1 ppm.

rules.name: Melamine Ban
rules.description: Melamine is banned in food products.

rules.name: Moisture Content
rules.description: Moisture must not exceed 6% for shelf stability.

rules.name: Acid Insoluble Ash
rules.description: Acid insoluble ash must not exceed 0.1%.
